displayName: Zara API - Prices by Country, Stock by Size, Stores, Product Data
description: Zara API for Zara prices by country - one Zara reference's price, sale price and online stock by size in each Zara market, in that market's currency (references are the same in every market; product ids usually are); prices takes one reference and up to 10 countries per call. Keyword search, product detail with composition and every colour's sizes, online stock per size, units per size in physical stores, stores with opening hours, materials, care and country of production, the category tree and category lists, special prices and new arrivals, search suggestions. 102 storefronts. 12 endpoints, 2 credits per call (4 or 6 on some, 1 on China). No reviews (Zara shows none), no price history (poll).

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
